heard: A giant star will explode in our galaxy every year. Usually, our galaxy sees a supernova only once a century. But 25,000 light years away, the Milky Way's heart is charging up. NASA's Chandra telescope caught a flare 400 times brighter than normal. Our central black hole has the mass of 4 million suns. A dense ring of gas is now reaching a critical density. A massive starburst episode begins in 200 million years. One star will then die in a supernova every single year. our galaxy's heart is preparing to detonate every year.
